selectionRule: The selected text/father location is always visible, even when its phase importance would normally be below the current zoom threshold.

identityResolution.rule: Resolve source rows through renderingIdentityId/aliasOf before collision detection and background rendering.
identityResolution.selectedObjectRule: A selected object may use any source alias, but its background label is rendered once through the canonical visual identity.
identityResolution.dateNameRule: Use the active phase displayName rather than the source-row canonicalName.

temporalRendering.noActivePhase: Do not render the place in the background. Selected object pins remain visible.
temporalRendering.importanceRule: Use the active phase importance, not legacyDisplayHint, once a place is preliminary or reviewed.
temporalRendering.unreviewedRule: Unreviewed locations remain deep-zoom only until researched.
